senses.definition: A sudden, intense, loud sound, as made for example by cymbals.
examples: The piece ended in a crescendo, building up to a crash of cymbals.
After the lightning came the crash of thunder.

senses.definition: An automobile, airplane, or other vehicle accident.
examples: She broke two bones in her body in a car crash.

senses.definition: (computing) A malfunction of computer software or hardware which causes it to shut down or become partially or totally inoperable.
examples: My computer had a crash so I had to reboot it.

senses.definition: (finance) A sudden large decline in the value of money, stocks or other assets, etc., especially one that causes additional economic difficulties.
(informal) A comedown from a drug.
(collective) A group of rhinoceroses.
examples:

(intransitive) To collide with something destructively; to fall or come down violently.
examples: When the car crashed into a house, the driver was heavily injured.

senses.definition: (transitive) To cause something to collide with something else, especially when this results in damage.
examples: I'm sorry for crashing the bike into a wall. I'll pay for repairs.

senses.definition: (transitive) To hit or strike with force.
